cc:Work.dc:title: Queen Concept (MONOLITH Edition - v1.0)
cc:Work.dc:description: The queen of the tall MONOLITH concept set, drawn to stand beside Dennis's castle-concept.svg: a serene head under a stone diadem with gold points, a gold halo crossed by seven sun rays, and a wrapped robe whose sash, drape and fold fall over a fluted chiton cut like the knight's pillar, on the castle's two-tier plinth.
